<div class="card-body">
'''Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">老いたな、かつての力はないぞ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ベイダーとオビ＝ワンの両方が戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数を１枚加える。２：「ジェダイの帰還」「ジェダイ・ライトセーバー」「ジェダイの気配」か「ベン翁」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-280o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「戻ってくるべきではなかったな。」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' You Have Grown Old. Your Former Power Is Gone.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are both participating in a battle. Add one battle destiny. 2. Cancel Return Of A Jedi, Jedi Lightsaber, [[Jedi Presence]], or Old Ben.

'''Lore:''' “You should not have come back.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
